'''Strang''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Assault Core Set" />

==Behind the scenes==
'''Strang''' was first mentioned in the starter set of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] tactical miniatures [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Assault]]''.
